newsitem.title: USA: US spot propane gains on position squaring.
newsitem.headline: US spot propane gains on position squaring.

text.p: U.S. spot propane prices rose in midday moderate trade on Wednesday as players began to square their positions before the long Memorial Day holiday weekend.
Propane also drew strength from the early rise in NYMEX July crude oil futures, which were responding to a sharp drop in stocks.

In the U.S. Gulf Coast, Mont Belvieu, Texas, spot propane regained the half cent lost Tuesday, trading midday between 35.75 cents and 36.00 cents a gallon. Conway, Kansas, traded 37.25 cents, a quarter cents above Tuesday.
Belvieu normal butane was steady, although the Conway markets were up a quarter cent.
-- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk, 1 212 859 1631
